mapper.select: SELECT merchant_id FROM shop WHERE id=#{shopId} AND region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE
SELECT FROM complaint_ticket t LEFT JOIN shop s ON s.id=t.shop_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id=t.user_id WHERE t.id=#{id} AND t.region=#{region} AND t.is_deleted=FALSE
SELECT FROM complaint_ticket t LEFT JOIN shop s ON s.id=t.shop_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id=t.user_id WHERE t.id=#{id} AND t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.region=#{region} AND t.is_deleted=FALSE
SELECT FROM complaint_ticket t LEFT JOIN shop s ON s.id=t.shop_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id=t.user_id WHERE t.id=#{id} AND t.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND t.region=#{region} AND t.is_deleted=FALSE

SELECT id,ticket_id,actor_type,actor_id,action,remark,created_at FROM complaint_log WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE complaint_ticket SET merchant_reply=#{reply},merchant_replied_at=#{now},status=2,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND status IN (1,2) AND is_deleted=FALSE

UPDATE complaint_ticket SET status=#{status},resolution=#{resolution},resolved_by=#{resolvedBy},resolved_at=#{now},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND region=#{region} AND status IN (1,2) AND is_deleted=FALSE
